ambiguous.reason: Central concept of metamorphosis — search for 'change' or 'transform' in Boardmaker; a before/after caterpillar-to-butterfly icon is ideal

notes: Core theme is patience and metamorphosis. 'Wait' and 'impatient' are high-priority fringe words because they are the central emotional/behavioural concepts of the book and have strong carry-over value for SPED students (waiting is a common IEP goal). 'Metamorphosis' may be replaced with 'change' if Boardmaker does not have a clear icon — the concept is critical to the story. 'Wiggle' supports the caterpillar's movement inside the cocoon and is fun/motivating for students. Existing activity_images (cocoon, butterfly, leaf) and aac_extras (wait, change, grow) align well with this book's vocabulary — reuse where possible to reduce production work.
